levels.surface: أبي الجوزاء المنبّه بن عبد اللّه
زيد بن عليّ بن الحسين بن عليّ بن أبي طالب

notes: Rule 11: al-Faqih's statement of his routes («فقد رويته» ; «طرق») to a book, with no saying. The reading is given but the ruling is needed.
Route 1 ends at the father «أبي» (relation); the father's own chain is not written.
Route 2 ends at Zayd, the book's source (occurrence 2; the first mention opens the sentence).
